_comment: Travis County, TX (FIPS 48453), assembled by web research because api.census.gov is blocked from the build environment. Published figures, not a live API pull. Every field is marked SOURCED or ESTIMATED in _provenance. Re-run with --live for the real thing.

_provenance.income lt25, 25to50, 50to75, 75to100, 15: ESTIMATED — full bracket table not reachable. Constrained to the sourced <$10K share of 4.7%, the two sourced brackets above, and the sourced median: 51% of households below $100K puts the modeled median near $98K against the published $97,169.
_provenance.pre1980_share: ESTIMATED — 0.22, inferred from a sourced median year built of 1999. No published pre-1980 share found.
_provenance.total_establishments: SOURCED — 42,837 private employer establishments, County Business Patterns 2023
_provenance.nonemployer_total: SOURCED — 147,031 nonemployer establishments, Nonemployer Statistics 2022 (not broken out by industry here)
_provenance.food_establishments: ESTIMATED — ~9% of establishments, a typical national share. Only affects hood cleaning, which is over a $5K budget.
_provenance.nonemployers by NAICS: NOT AVAILABLE — per-trade counts could not be retrieved by search, so service trades carry no competitor count and are not ranked.
